evidence: Extracted all 61 distinctive probe tokens the judge is told to create across every judge.toml (JUDGE-CS0..CS1, W0-W3, WL0-WL1, L1, M1-M3, ME1-ME2, R0-R3/R1B/RX, X0-X1, TE, H0-H3/H1C, E1, F1-F2, P1-P3, U1-U3, D1-D2, O, LA/LB/LE/LG/LR/LV, T0-T1, Q1-Q6, S0-S2, G1, K1-K3) and grepped environment/, solution/ (seed, server.js, public markup) and instruction.md: zero hits. The seed creates no runtime messages beyond seed_data.json (server.js seedDatabase 93-126; agent and solution seeds byte-identical, sha b256f85e... matching the evidence index). Non-token created values are also absent: search probes '100%', 'A_1', 'AB1', 'X*9', 'XY9', '1000 pounds' only match styles.css CSS widths (not data); 'Persist gone', 'Order C/A/B' absent; edit target 'Costs estimate sent to Gwen JUDGE-TE' differs from seeded 'Costs estimate sent to Gwen.'; state probes are not pre-satisfied (persistence sets M-12 timer to 30 from seeded null and walls Sian from M-11 which seed leaves unwalled; wall_added_live walls Sian who is unwalled in seed; timer_changes passes through 7 and off before re-reading 30; Gwen's >=2 M-13 unread relies on new Harriet U1/U2 since seed read_up_to is K-9). No token is a substring of another token used in a negative search (JUDGE-X0, JUDGE-TE, JUDGE-O, JUDGE-D1 exact-once), so earlier criteria cannot pre-fail or pre-satisfy later searches. Weak-app probe: an app that hardcodes seed content cannot show any JUDGE value; a conforming app could fail only via the '-2' retry convention, which is state-relative. Static/source review only; not a run of the private check-probe-not-in-seed.py executable.
